name: R-454B
uses: New residential and light-commercial A/C and heat pumps replacing R-410A (new equipment only, not a retrofit).

name: R-32
uses: New ductless and ducted A/C and heat pumps replacing R-410A (new equipment only).

name: R-410A
uses: Residential and commercial A/C and heat pumps built before the 2025 A2L transition; now a service refrigerant.

name: R-22
uses: Legacy A/C and refrigeration. US production and import ended 1 Jan 2020; service from reclaimed or stockpiled gas only.

name: R-407C
uses: Retrofit and new-equipment replacement for R-22 in A/C and some refrigeration.

name: R-466A
uses: Non-flammable lower-GWP alternative to R-410A for new A/C equipment.
checks: Honeywell Solstice N41 presentation (average pressure, bar)

name: R-422D
uses: Retrofit for R-22 in A/C and medium/low-temperature refrigeration.

name: R-438A
uses: Mineral-oil compatible retrofit for R-22 in A/C and refrigeration.
checks: DuPont/Chemours ISCEON MO99 PT chart (source table)

name: R-421A
uses: Retrofit for R-22 in A/C and medium-temperature refrigeration.

name: R-417A
uses: Retrofit for R-22 in A/C and refrigeration.

name: R-427A
uses: Retrofit for R-22 in A/C, medium- and low-temperature systems.

name: R-404A
uses: Medium- and low-temperature commercial refrigeration; being phased down in new equipment.

name: R-507A
uses: Low- and medium-temperature commercial refrigeration (similar to R-404A).

name: R-448A
uses: Lower-GWP replacement for R-404A, R-507A and R-22 in supermarket and commercial refrigeration (new and retrofit).

name: R-449A
uses: Lower-GWP replacement for R-404A, R-507A and R-22 in commercial refrigeration (new and retrofit).

name: R-407A
uses: Replacement for R-22 and R-404A in medium- and low-temperature refrigeration.

name: R-407F
uses: Replacement for R-22 and R-404A in commercial refrigeration.

name: R-452A
uses: Transport refrigeration and retrofit of R-404A/R-507A.

name: R-455A
uses: Low-GWP option for new self-contained commercial refrigeration.

name: R-454A
uses: Low-GWP option for new commercial refrigeration.

name: R-290
uses: Self-contained commercial refrigeration (reach-ins, ice machines), some heat pumps. Flammable: follow charge limits and A3 service practice.

name: R-600a
uses: Household refrigerators and small appliances. Flammable: follow A3 service practice.

name: R-744
uses: Transcritical and cascade supermarket systems, heat-pump water heaters. Very high pressures; critical point 87.8 °F.

name: R-717
uses: Industrial refrigeration (cold storage, food processing). Toxic: follow IIAR and site safety rules.

name: R-134a
uses: Automotive A/C (older vehicles), medium-temperature refrigeration, chillers, appliances.

name: R-513A
uses: Lower-GWP replacement for R-134a in chillers and medium-temperature refrigeration (not automotive).

name: R-450A
uses: Lower-GWP replacement for R-134a in medium-temperature refrigeration.

name: R-1234yf
uses: Automotive A/C in most new vehicles (replaced R-134a).

name: R-1234ze(E)
uses: Chillers, heat pumps and some medium-temperature systems.

name: R-12
uses: Legacy automotive A/C and refrigeration (pre-1995). Production banned; recovered gas only.

name: R-123
uses: Low-pressure centrifugal chillers. Production for new equipment ended in the US in 2020.

name: R-1233zd(E)
uses: Low-pressure centrifugal chillers replacing R-123.
